title: サウジアラビアRCの後に・破竹之勢

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf blows the competition away and takes first place. Her performance bodes well for the Satsuki Sho, although it seems to have intimidated the general manager.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Symboli Rudolf encounters Maruzensky, the "Beast." Much like Rudolf, Maruzensky's formidable skills have made her the talk of the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Could this potential rivalry bring out a new side of Symboli Rudolf? I can't help but wonder what the future might hold.
